findings.message: "#line1" has CSS `transform: translateX(-40px)` and a GSAP tween animates x. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateX(-40px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: x: -40. Example: tl.fromTo('#line1', { x: -40 }, { x: -40, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.
